usage: This is the standard, everyday way to ask someone's name in Morocco. It is used in both casual and semi-formal situations across all ages. In some regions, you might hear ash smitk instead of shno smitk, but both are universally understood.

variants.label: alternative word for what
variants.note: Uses ash instead of shno, which is equally common depending on the region.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: more formal
variants.note: Used in administrative contexts or when being extremely polite to an elder.

examples.english: Nice to meet you, what's your name?
